bank_accounts_owner_check.name: bank_accounts_owner_check
bank_accounts_owner_check.value: ("bank_accounts"."scope"='PLATFORM' and "bank_accounts"."company_id" is null) or ("bank_accounts"."scope"='COMPANY' and "bank_accounts"."company_id" is not null)

terms.name: terms
terms.default: 'The hold fee reserves the selected plot for seven days after payment approval. If the hold expires, the refundable amount is calculated from the snapshotted refund percentage less the administrative deduction.'

reservation_commercial_settings_values_c.name: reservation_commercial_settings_values_check
reservation_commercial_settings_values_c.value: "reservation_commercial_settings"."checkout_lock_minutes" > 0 and "reservation_commercial_settings"."hold_payment_window_minutes" > 0 and "reservation_commercial_settings"."hold_duration_minutes" > 0 and "reservation_commercial_settings"."hold_fee" > 0 and "reservation_commercial_settings"."refund_percentage" between 0 and 100 and "reservation_commercial_settings"."administrative_deduction" >= 0

reservations_terms_check.name: reservations_terms_check
reservations_terms_check.value: ("reservations"."type" = 'CHECKOUT_LOCK') or ("reservations"."hold_duration_minutes_snapshot" > 0 and "reservations"."hold_fee_snapshot" > 0 and "reservations"."refund_percentage_snapshot" between 0 and 100 and "reservations"."administrative_deduction_snapshot" >= 0 and "reservations"."refundable_amount_snapshot" >= 0 and "reservations"."terms_version_snapshot" is not null and "reservations"."terms_snapshot" is not null)

land_alerts_price_range_check.name: land_alerts_price_range_check
land_alerts_price_range_check.value: "land_alerts"."min_price" is null OR "land_alerts"."max_price" is null OR "land_alerts"."min_price" <= "land_alerts"."max_price"

company_ledger_source_check.name: company_ledger_source_check
company_ledger_source_check.value: ("company_ledger_entries"."payment_id" is not null)::int + ("company_ledger_entries"."payout_request_id" is not null)::int = 1

screening_layers_company_scope_check.name: screening_layers_company_scope_check
screening_layers_company_scope_check.value: ("screening_layers"."provenance" = 'company_declared' AND "screening_layers"."company_id" IS NOT NULL AND "screening_layers"."estate_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("screening_layers"."provenance" <> 'company_declared' AND "screening_layers"."estate_id" IS NULL)
